<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 520 340" width="520" height="340">
  <rect width="520" height="340" fill="#ffffff" />
  
  <style>
    .label { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #000; }
    .caption { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; fill: #000; text-anchor: middle; }
    .line { stroke: #000; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .hatch { stroke: #000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-dasharray: 4, 4; }
  </style>

  <!-- Water tank / body of water gun -->
  <!-- Main rectangular body outline: x: 120 to 420, y: 70 to 180 -->
  <rect x="120" y="70" width="300" height="110" class="line" fill="#fff" />

  <!-- Dotted fill for water inside main body -->
  <!-- Let's draw subtle horizontal/vertical dotted grid or hatch for water -->
  <g class="hatch">
    <line x1="130" y1="90" x2="410" y2="90" />
    <line x1="130" y1="110" x2="410" y2="110" />
    <line x1="130" y1="130" x2="410" y2="130" />
    <line x1="130" y1="150" x2="410" y2="150" />
    <line x1="130" y1="170" x2="410" y2="170" />

    <line x1="150" y1="75" x2="150" y2="175" />
    <line x1="190" y1="75" x2="190" y2="175" />
    <line x1="230" y1="75" x2="230" y2="175" />
    <line x1="270" y1="75" x2="270" y2="175" />
    <line x1="310" y1="75" x2="310" y2="175" />
    <line x1="350" y1="75" x2="350" y2="175" />
    <line x1="390" y1="75" x2="390" y2="175" />
  </g>

  <!-- Narrow cylinder at the bottom of the tank -->
  <!-- Cylinder walls inside the bottom of the tank: x: 160 to 240, y: 150 to 180 -->
  <rect x="160" y="150" width="80" height="30" class="line" fill="#fff" />

  <!-- Piston inside the narrow cylinder -->
  <rect x="180" y="153" width="12" height="24" class="line" fill="#cccccc" />
  <!-- Piston rod extending left/down to trigger -->
  <path d="M 180 165 L 145 195" class="line" />

  <!-- Trigger below the body, linked to piston -->
  <!-- Trigger curves down from bottom of body, hinged near top, connects to piston rod -->
  <path d="M 155 180 C 145 200, 135 220, 150 230" class="line" />
  <path d="M 145 195 L 155 205" class="line" /> <!-- connection line -->

  <!-- Handle angling down and back from under the body -->
  <path d="M 240 180 L 220 270 C 215 280, 225 290, 235 285 L 275 240 L 280 180" class="line" fill="#fff" />

  <!-- Narrow nozzle at the right end -->
  <!-- Nozzle protruding from right side: x: 420 to 460, y: 115 to 135 -->
  <path d="M 420 115 L 460 122 L 460 128 L 420 135" class="line" fill="#fff" />

  <!-- Stopper covering the nozzle -->
  <!-- Cap over the nozzle tip at x=460 -->
  <path d="M 457 119 C 463 119, 465 131, 457 131 Z" class="line" fill="#666" />

  <!-- Labels and Leader Lines -->
  
  <!-- Water label -->
  <text x="250" y="115" class="label">water</text>

  <!-- Piston label & pointer -->
  <text x="110" y="145" class="label">piston</text>
  <path d="M 145 145 L 182 160" class="line" />

  <!-- Trigger label & pointer -->
  <text x="80" y="225" class="label">trigger</text>
  <path d="M 125 225 L 145 215" class="line" />

  <!-- Nozzle label & pointer -->
  <text x="440" y="85" class="label">nozzle</text>
  <path d="M 455 90 L 445 120" class="line" />

  <!-- Stopper label & pointer -->
  <text x="475" y="155" class="label">stopper</text>
  <path d="M 470 150 L 462 130" class="line" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="260" y="315" class="caption">Fig. 5.1</text>

</svg>
